title: Find the highest bonuses
prompt: Return the first_name and bonus_pct of the three employees with the highest bonus_pct, highest first. Employees with no bonus_pct do not count. When two employees have the same bonus_pct, put them in first_name order, A to Z.
hints: Where do rows with a missing bonus_pct land in descending order?
Keep the NULL rows away from the top, then decide what breaks a tie.
ORDER BY bonus_pct DESC NULLS LAST, first_name LIMIT 3

wrongAnswers.misconception: Sorts descending and lets the missing values come first.
Sorts ascending and returns the lowest bonuses.

feedback: Look at the first row. It should hold a real bonus_pct, the highest one, and not NULL.
